Time-sensitive; one player estimates about 12 days. Do not dawdle.

item_hints.Rotten Apple: Not sold rotten. Get an Apple (goblins near the Sacred Arbor, or alchemists for 50 G), carry it and rest about a week (bench Doze Off or inn) until it rots.
item_hints.Rotten Fish: Catch fish in the shallow water north of the Sacred Arbor, then rest in the same way until it rots in your pack.
item_hints.Nutriabh: Quest item Doireann cooks from the rotten apple and fish. Give it to Sara at Brokkr's Smithy.
item_hints.Scalecinder: Quest item: green powder piles in Stragglers' Cave (right up the hill before the bridge outside Bakbattahl). About 6 piles; collect while Brokkr rants.

name: Readvent of Calamity
how: After Seat of the Sovran, revisit Melve a few days later and a dragon attacks. Break the red growths on its legs and neck until it flies off. Rest (inn or camp), then enter Ulrika's house; after the envoy scene, talk to her and agree to stay the night. You wake and she is gone. Find her in Harve Village, then tell Lennart in Melve to finish.
best: Repelling is enough; talk to Sigurd after the fight to unlock Mystic Spearhand. Felling it with the watchtower ballista is optional.
rewards: 2000 XP, 4500 G, Ring of Grit
warnings: Ulrika only appears in Harve once Monster Culling and Scaly Invaders are done.
Cancelled once Feast of Deception (main quest) begins.
Do not kill envoy Martin; players report it can break the quest.
follow_ups: Finding Ulrika starts Trouble on the Cape in Harve; leads to Home Is Where the Hearth Is.

name: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
how: After Readvent of Calamity (Brant points you back after An Unsettling Encounter), enter occupied Melve: bribe the gate guard 5,000 G or climb the wall right of the gate. Bring Lennart (Ulrika's house) 4 swords, then fight the soldiers outside with the villagers for about a minute. Wait a few days, go to Harve, and talk to Ulrika on the docks at night to finish.
best: Climb the wall instead of bribing, and let Ian and Norbert distract the guards so you can take the swords from the storehouse.
rewards: 2200 XP, 12,000 G, Ring of Assurance
warnings: Pawns cannot enter Melve; you fight with the villagers only.
Hitting a villager can break the quest (player report).
Ulrika only meets you at night: doze on the bench at Bayside Home or rest at the inn. If she never shows, finish Trouble on the Cape first.
follow_ups: Advances Ulrika's romance; Melve villagers relocate to Harve.

item_hints.Trusty Sword: Confiscated villager swords in the Melve storehouse by the gate: one chest holds 2, another 1. Ian and Norbert (outside Lennart's house) draw the guards away. Or bring any swords you own.
item_hints.Iron Sword: The fourth sword, in the third chest of the same storehouse. Swords bought in Vernworth also count.

name: Dulled Steel, Cold Forge
how: After Seat of the Sovran, talk to Roman in the Vernworth Castle courtyard (he may only appear at night) and follow him. The Vernworth smith sends you to Brokkr's Smithy in Bakbattahl. Brokkr refuses; leave the room, wait for him to leave the building, then talk to Sara. Mine Glimmercoal in Digger's Ruins (SW of Bakbattahl), bring it to Sara, and accept her offer to repair the sword to finish.
best: Turn in 25 Glimmercoal (minimum 15) for the full reward. Turn the lantern off: real Glimmercoal glows green.
rewards: 2800 XP, 12,000 G (with 25 Glimmercoal; fewer reportedly pays less)
warnings: Handing Sara the sword starts Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge, which runs on in-game time. Do it when you can go to Agamen Volcanic Island soon.
Glymercole looks similar but is not accepted.
Keep the sword in your inventory, not storage, or Sara's repair option may not appear. Refusing her leaves the quest open.
Slimes and goblins drop from above in Digger's Ruins.
follow_ups: Entrusting the sword to Sara starts Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge.

item_hints.Dulled Regalia Sword: Quest item Roman gives you. Keep it in your inventory and hand it to Sara at Brokkr's Smithy, Bakbattahl.
item_hints.Glimmercoal: Gathered, not bought: green-glowing deposits in Digger's Ruins SW of Bakbattahl (up to about 30). Lantern off to spot them. Glymercole look-alikes are not accepted.

name: Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge
how: Spend a few days away, check on Sara at Brokkr's Smithy, and repeat once. Next visit she is gone and Brokkr sends you to Mountain Base Cave (SW of Geyser Hamlet). Clear the plank path, find her at the natural forge, run her back to the entrance before her Blazehammer cools, collect the Restored Regalia Sword at the smithy, and give it to Roman in Vernworth.

choices.outcome: Normal completion; the most gold.

choices.option: Give Roman a forgery, sell the real one
choices.outcome: Ibrahim forges it for 7,000 G; Roman pays 11,000 G and the original sells for about 18,000 G. Net about 22,000 G, less than the real sword.
choices.rewards: 11,000 G from Roman plus the sale

best: Clear the cave on the way in so the escort back is fast, then hand Roman the genuine sword for 35,000 G.
warnings: The escort is timed: reach the cave entrance before the Blazehammer cools. Sara's lines hint how much time is left.
Keep Sara alive; a player reports reviving her counted as a failure and blocked smithy services.
Passing days between visits is expected, but do not leave her missing for long once Brokkr sends you to the cave.
follow_ups: Completing it opens Brokkr's Smithy services in Bakbattahl.

item_hints.Restored Regalia Sword: Quest item: Sara hands it over at Brokkr's Smithy after the cave escort. Give it to Roman (Vernworth Castle courtyard). Ibrahim's Scrap Store can forge a copy for 7,000 G.

name: Welcome to Battahl
how: Triggers on your first visit to Bakbattahl: turn right at the Oxcart Station corner and pass the tavern, and Roger stops you. Fight his three men in the narrow passage. The quest ends when you win or when Raghnall steps in and settles it.
best: Prep gear and items first, then beat all three quickly without taking repeated hits, before Raghnall steps in. That pays the most.
rewards: Win 3-on-1: 2800 XP, Fruit Wine, 13,500 G. Win 1-on-1 vs Taleef: 2800 XP, Fruit Wine, 8500 G. Lose 1-on-1: 2800 XP, -3000 G.
warnings: Too little damage or repeated hits and Raghnall turns it into a 1-on-1 vs Taleef for less gold; lose that and you pay 3000 G.
Pawns cannot join this fight (one player says ordering Go! brings them in).
Chasing a knocked-back enemy too far may count as a loss (player report).
follow_ups: Required for Tensions on the Highroad (Raghnall's chain), which leads to Clash and Conclusion.

name: Spellbound
how: At Eini's Home north of Melve, talk to Trysha while her grandparents are out (or carry her outside). Give her 3 original grimoires at once for the Turquoise Ring. Rest a day at the nearby camp and return: during her magick outburst, dodge until she stops casting, then grab her. Rest another day at camp and return for the final scene to finish.

choices.outcome: Turquoise Ring now; after the outburst, Trysha and Eini each give a Maister teaching.
choices.rewards: 2000 XP, 3000 G, Cast Stone, Turquoise Ring, Conjurer's Jottings (Meteoron), Enchanter's Almanac (Celestial Paean)

choices.outcome: She doubts her aptitude and the outburst event does not happen properly. No Maister teachings.
Fextralife lists a failed outcome where Trysha dies (e.g. if she is attacked); a Wakestone reportedly still allows the good ending.

best: Give Trysha 3 real grimoires and Myrddin 3 forgeries. In the outburst, dodge until she stops casting, then grab her; never attack her.
warnings: Do not give all 5 originals to one NPC. Trysha needs 3 real ones; Myrddin accepts forgeries.
Eini or Eino dying can block the outburst. Check the Vernworth charnel house and revive with a Wakestone.
Time-limited: return after about a day of rest each time; do not wander off for long.
Dudley leaves after you buy Fulminous Shield; buy his other stock first.
follow_ups: Linked to The Sorcerer's Appraisal (Myrddin wants the same books). Keep the Turquoise Ring for Myrddin.

item_hints.Let There Be Light: Taken, not bought: desk upstairs in Myrddin's manor, Checkpoint Rest Town. Enter via the outside balcony; using the inside stairs makes him attack.
item_hints.Fulminous Shield: Bought from traveling merchant Dudley near Melve's north entrance for about 5,000 G. Buy his other wares first; he leaves after.
item_hints.Nation's Death Knell: Two originals: red chest on 2F of Waterfall Cave (spawns a Wight), and under the bell in the Ancient Battleground castle; take that one after Tolled to Rest or that quest bugs.
item_hints.Howling Blizzard: Same red chest on 2F of Waterfall Cave, or trade a Fulminous Shield to Wendy in the Nameless Village.
item_hints.Towering Earth: Given by Waldhar after The Caged Magistrate; if missed, talk to him in The Gracious Hand's Vaults under the Vernworth slums.
item_hints.Wakestone: Only needed if Eini, Eino or Trysha dies: use it on the body at the Vernworth charnel house.

name: The Sorcerer's Appraisal
how: After Seat of the Sovran, go to Myrddin's manor in Checkpoint Rest Town wearing the Courtly Tunic and Breeches; he opens the door, then talk to him inside. He asks for 5 grimoires, but handing over 3 at once finishes it. If he asks about Trysha or Meteoron, answer honestly with the Turquoise Ring on you; he may need you to rest a day and return.

choices.outcome: Usually accepted, and you keep the originals for Trysha. Reports conflict: some got full rewards, others less gold.
choices.rewards: 2100 XP, 11,000 G, Ares Morpho Robe, Myrddin's Chronicle (Maelstrom)

choices.option: Tell him about Trysha, show the ring
choices.outcome: Keeps the full reward. He may go to ask Eini about her; rest a day or more and return to finish.

choices.option: Refuse to discuss Trysha or lie
choices.outcome: Partial or no reward reported; without the ring he may throw you out.

best: Give Myrddin 3 forgeries from Ibrahim and keep the originals for Trysha. If he asks about Trysha or Meteoron, tell the truth with the Turquoise Ring on you.
warnings: Without the Courtly Tunic and Breeches he will not let you in, or attacks.
Give only 3 books; Trysha needs 3 originals for her teachings.
If he stalls after Spellbound, wear the Turquoise Ring and rest a few days before returning.
follow_ups: Shares grimoires with Spellbound.

item_hints.Let There Be Light: Taken, not bought: desk upstairs in Myrddin's manor, Checkpoint Rest Town. Enter via the outside balcony; using the inside stairs makes him attack.
item_hints.Fulminous Shield: Bought from traveling merchant Dudley near Melve's north entrance for about 5,000 G. Buy his other wares first; he leaves after.
item_hints.Nation's Death Knell: Two originals: red chest on 2F of Waterfall Cave (spawns a Wight), and under the bell in the Ancient Battleground castle; take that one after Tolled to Rest.
item_hints.Howling Blizzard: Same red chest on 2F of Waterfall Cave, or trade a Fulminous Shield to Wendy in the Nameless Village.
item_hints.Towering Earth: Given by Waldhar after The Caged Magistrate; if missed, talk to him in The Gracious Hand's Vaults under the Vernworth slums.
item_hints.Courtly Tunic: Worn to enter. Reward from Sven's The Ornate Box, a chest in Vernworth Hall's west hallway, or buy at Ibrahim's Scrap Store if lost.
item_hints.Courtly Breeches: Worn with the tunic. Same sources as the Courtly Tunic.
item_hints.Turquoise Ring: Trysha's reward for 3 grimoires in Spellbound. Have it on you (some say equipped) when Myrddin asks about her.

name: Put a Spring in Thy Step
how: Past Drabnir's Grotto on the road into Agamen Volcanic Island, the dwarf Gautstafr asks for 3 wildflowers or herbs; deliver them to him on the road. Meet him at Windwalker's Home (follow the coast to the connecting islet), then talk again and pick "Offer to escort him" to the hot spring in Geyser Hamlet. The quest ends when he reaches the spring and Cliodhna appears.
best: Walk, don't run, or carry him; clear magma scales, hobgoblins and the stone golem ahead of him and arrive before nightfall.
rewards: 4800 XP, 23,000 G, Laurel Circlet, unlocks the Magick Archer vocation
warnings: Afterward, talk to Cliodhna again for Spellbow's Paradox (Martyr's Bolt); easy to miss.
Keep Gautstafr alive on the escort; at the fork take the right path and enter Geyser Hamlet through the scaffold tunnel.
The log may stay on "deliver the wildflowers"; ignore it and go to his house on the map (player report).
follow_ups: Cliodhna becomes the Magick Archer maister.

item_hints.Morningtide: Any 3 wildflowers or herbs are accepted (Morningtide is one). Pick them along the road near Gautstafr; no need to buy.

name: A Veil of Gossamer Clouds
how: After Feast of Deception, Sven (his castle chambers) gives you Disa's unfinished letter. Waldhar in the Gracious Hand's Vaults reads it as a love letter. For the better ending, take the oxcart to Bakbattahl, go to the south side of Flamebearer Palace, cross the bridge to the Forbidden Magick Research Lab, take the letter from Workshop #2, and show it to Sven ("See for yourself") to finish.

choices.option: Report it as a love letter
choices.outcome: After Waldhar's reading, tell Sven "'Twas a love letter". The quest ends with the smaller reward.

choices.option: Bring the Letter to Lord Phaesus
choices.outcome: Taken from Workshop #2 in the Bakbattahl lab and shown to Sven.

best: Skip the love-letter report: take the Letter to Lord Phaesus from the Bakbattahl lab and show it to Sven.
warnings: Telling Sven it was a love letter ends the quest with the smaller reward.
Lab entry: players report guards turning hostile via the palace; the back entrance, a hood or a Beastren Mask reportedly helps. Do not draw weapons.
The Waldhar route needs The Caged Magistrate and The Heel of History done.

item_hints.Letter to Lord Phaesus: Taken, not bought: middle of the table in Workshop #2 of the Forbidden Magick Research Lab (eavesdrop on Yglie and Jerome first). If lost, Ibrahim in Checkpoint Rest Town may sell a replacement.
item_hints.Unfinished Letter: Quest item Sven gives you at the start.

name: A Candle in the Storm
how: After Shadowed Prayers, talk to Menella by the Volcanic Island Armory. Pay brigand Herman in the Bakbattahl Gaol 5,000 G to talk, report to Menella, then tell prisoner Ashe the Empress's fake location. Meet Menella at Bakbattahl's west entrance, follow the marker to the hideout NW of town, and pick a side on the plan. When Irmhild arrives, follow her inside; the quest ends after her reveal.

choices.outcome: Irmhild tells you to kill the Empress. Strike once at Nadinia on the bed without hitting Irmhild; Irmhild explains her motive and Menella arrests her.
Irmhild spots the fake and flees. Fight Coral Snakes while protecting Menella, then attack Irmhild; she kills herself and her motive stays hidden.
Ends the quest without the best ending (player reports).

best: Support the proposal, save at an inn first, then hit Nadinia on the bed once when Irmhild asks, avoiding Irmhild. Ring plus 25,000 G.
warnings: Do not advance the main story back to the Excavation Site first; GamerGuides says it keeps the quest and Menella available.
In the reveal, strike only the Empress once. Hitting Irmhild or delaying spoils the best ending.
If you freed the brigand earlier, players report he may be missing from the gaol.

name: Mercy among Thieves
how: On the Battahl side of Checkpoint Rest Town, give the boy Toumi (tent past the inn) non-rotten food twice. Talk to the two men opposite the Oxcart Station, then Lyssandro (white robes) and agree to help. Ask travelers on the road south about a raid, chase the fleeing bandits SW into the Coral Snakes' Hideout, and fight through. The quest ends when the leader flees and Hugo is captured.
best: Loot the hideout's 2F chests: Frosted Edges, Decapitator and Ring of Disfavor.
warnings: Do not kill Hugo; it breaks the chain unless you revive him right away with a Wakestone.
A bandit cuts the near rope bridge; use the farther bridge or the ladders in the middle area.
After the quest a Grim Ogre can spawn in the bandit tent area.
follow_ups: Hugo is jailed in Bakbattahl, which unlocks Off the Pilfered Path.

name: Off the Pilfered Path
how: Have a Battahl Residence Permit, then enter Bakbattahl Gaol. Talk to Hugo, guard Dietrich, and Brefft (opposite Hugo) about Hugo's parents and Lanzo. To free Hugo, bribe head gaoler Ekratt 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000 G on three separate days (doze or rest between). Hugo then waits outside the gaol: talk to him and offer a job to finish.

choices.option: Keep the truth from Hugo, bribe him out
choices.outcome: Safest route. He waits outside the gaol for you to offer work.
He kills Brefft, escapes and goes after Lanzo at the Ancient Battleground. Kill Lanzo first or Hugo dies and the quest ends.
Isaac's Wares (after Short-Sighted Ambition with the real book, Isaac gone) or Rose Chateau (after Every Rose Has Its Thorn). Best ending.
choices.rewards: 4500 XP, 7000 G, White-Leather Kerchief, Frosted Edges

choices.outcome: He sets off on his own (completes the quest). Some players report he gets angry or attacks.

best: Don't tell Hugo the truth. Bribe Ekratt 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 G over three days, then offer him a job you set up beforehand.
warnings: Set up a job first: finish Every Rose Has Its Thorn or Short-Sighted Ambition (real book to Isaac).
Without a Battahl Residence Permit, gaol guards attack you.
If Hugo goes after Lanzo, kill Lanzo (castle top floor) quickly; left for days they kill each other.
Using the gaol key or opening the cell starts a fight with guards and Hugo may die. Bribing is safer.
follow_ups: Hugo works at Isaac's Wares in Bakbattahl or the Rose Chateau in Vernworth.

item_hints.Makeshift Gaol Key: Bought from Ibrahim's Scrap Store (Checkpoint Rest Town) or Dudley for 3,000 G, or found in chests. Opens Hugo's cell but guards attack; the bribe route is safer.
item_hints.Battahl Residence Permit: From Ser Menella during Nation of the Lambent Flame (main quest), or by buying a Bakbattahl home. Needed to enter the gaol without guards attacking.

name: Tensions on the Highroad
how: After Welcome to Battahl and a return to Vernworth, soldier Simon approaches near the North Vernworth Oxcart Station (he patrols; check the Pawn Guild stairs if absent). Meet Ser Augustin's oxcart just outside Checkpoint Rest Town. When Raghnall stops it, take a side with one hit, chase Raghnall into Guerco Cavern, beat the Saurians with him, and exit the cave to finish.

choices.outcome: Drive off Simon's men. Raghnall reveals the escort was a trap to kill Augustin and frame you.
Same chase and reveal, but Raghnall likes you less. GamerGuides says half the gold; PowerPyx says the reward does not change.

best: Side with Raghnall: strike a guard standing far from him, then ignore stray monsters while chasing him into the cave.
warnings: A floor collapse in Guerco Cavern separates you from your pawns; be ready to fight hobgoblins and Saurians without them.
Simon asks you to keep the job secret from Captain Brant.
One player reports the oxcart getting stuck on the incline at the start. Save first.
follow_ups: Required for Clash and Conclusion (Raghnall's duel in Moonglint Tower).

item_hints.Escort Letter: Quest item Simon gives you when the job starts.

name: Clash and Conclusion
how: Starts automatically on an upper floor of Moonglint Tower during The Guardian Gigantus, only if Tensions on the Highroad is done. Raghnall demands a solo duel in a narrow corridor; pawns stay out. It ends either when he dies, or, if you deal him no damage (guard, parry, grab or pin) for about 2 minutes, when a cutscene plays and he walks away.

choices.outcome: He dies and the quest completes. A Wakestone revives him, but he only sits and repeats one line.
Guard, parry, grab or pin without hurting him until a scene plays. He says his job was not to kill you, hands you a key and leaves.

best: Spare him: deal no damage for about 2 minutes (guard, parry, grab) until the scene plays, for more gold, The Exalted and a key.
warnings: Missable: only during The Guardian Gigantus, needs Tensions on the Highroad finished, and is canceled once Legacy starts.
A single hit from a strong character, or knocking him off the edge, can kill him. Only guard and grab if you want to spare him.
Killing him and reviving him with a Wakestone does not give the spare rewards.
Sources differ on sparing: one says parry for about 2 minutes, another says keep grappling or pinning; no exact timer is confirmed.
follow_ups: Continue up the tower toward Legacy. Players report a spared or revived Raghnall turning up in the Unmoored World.

name: Chilling Tidings
how: After Seat of the Sovran, talk to Captain Brant, seated in Vernworth's Stardrop Inn (17:00-05:59): 'About the new Arisen...'. Rest at Shakir's Inn until morning for a dream, then see Brant again that night. Go to the fallen griffin by the waterfall in east Malachite Forest and tell Pekdre 'I am ready'. In Norgan, run past the Beorcans, follow Dorin into the settlement and talk to Jiera to finish.
rewards: 5,000 XP, 10,000 G, Norgan Portcrystal (paid on reaching the settlement); an Eternal Ferrystone if you lack one; optional Regeneration Elixir from Magistrate Waldhar
warnings: Brant only sits in the Stardrop Inn from 17:00 to 05:59. By day, sit on a bench and Doze Off until evening.
The marker points near Melve, but the griffin is at the east end of Malachite Forest: cross the river by Trevo Mine and follow the shore to the waterfall.
Recommended level 40. Beorcans ambush you on landing; run downhill. If you fall, you wake in the settlement and the quest still advances.
Normal portcrystals cannot be placed in Norgan; you can place up to five Norgan Portcrystals. Vermund portcrystals stay usable from Norgan.
follow_ups: Leads to Rumbles in the North. Opens settlement side quests: Hammer and Tongs (Hal), In for a Hare, in for a Hound (Ilsa), Sticks and Stones (Morgus), Relics of the Past (Jiera).

item_hints.Regeneration Elixir: Optional gift from Magistrate Waldhar: in the Vernworth Castle Gaol Tower, or in the archives under the slums after The Caged Magistrate.

name: Rumbles in the North
how: Leave the settlement through the stone arch and follow Valgr Ravine to Rivercave Campground (cave beside a rune-carved stump; rest and take the Heatstone). Climb to the Mountain Stronghold and enter the summit chamber: the Fallen Dragon crashes in. Survive until it heals itself and a cloaked warrior steps in. You wake in the Norgandian Inn; go outside for a scene, then talk to Dorin to finish.
warnings: The dragon cannot be killed here and gives no XP or loot. Just survive until the scene; don't burn your best curatives.
If Dorin won't talk after the scene outside the inn, go back into the inn and out again to retrigger it.
Ghouls keep spawning during the fight; bring Wakestones and use the pillars for cover.
follow_ups: Leads to Seeking the Sage. Opens The Truant Soldier, The Snatching-Beast, Village Defense, Reaching the Far Shore and Oh, to Be in Vermund. The arena is revisited for the Riddle of the Will.

name: Sealed History
how: Starts automatically after you consult Polyeidus. Port to Rivercave Campground, talk to Wash and follow the commission to the Mountain Stronghold. Open the frozen inner gate with the stone lever atop the round tower, pass Northwall Campground and North Valgrian Frostgrove to Brinerot Grotto, and go down to the Sealed Study. Wait a full day (Doze Off on the settlement bench), then ask Polyeidus at the study for his results.
rewards: No reward screen; several grimoires lie in the Sealed Study
warnings: Finishing: Polyeidus needs a full in-game day. Doze Off on a bench or rest, then return to the Sealed Study and ask about his research.
Bring Lantern Oil; the study is underground. Ferrystones do not work inside; activate the portcrystal at the top of the long stairs.
Brinerot Grotto's first passage is a dead end (portcullis locked from the far side). Backtrack and use the doorway by the damaged purple riftstone.
follow_ups: Polyeidus names Lorade Castle and The Castle in the Ice starts immediately. The study is used again in Soul Searching.

item_hints.Climbing Hook: Chest in the Northwall Campground cave, reached during this quest. Aymond also sells them.

name: Seeking the Sage
how: Follow Dorin to the watchtower west of the settlement; the top chest holds the Spirit Compass. Dorin then gives a Climbing Hook. Follow the compass marker past Beorcan Stronghold and through the Cavern of Faith to the Shrine of Wisdom. Ask the Sphinx 'Tell me of the Fallen Dragon' to get her three riddles. After all three are delivered, talk to Polyeidus in the settlement to finish.
rewards: Eye of the Sphinx (given when she poses the riddles); each riddle pays separately
warnings: Finishing: after the third riddle item, return to Polyeidus in the Norgandian Settlement and talk to him; that ends this quest and starts Sealed History.
Activate the Norgan Portcrystal next to the Shrine of Wisdom; you come back several times.
Bring about 5 Heatstones. Blizzards cause Chilled (lower max stamina) and blank the minimap; the compass marker still points the way.
Polyeidus, Dwayne and Jiera give riddle hints. The riddles can be done in any order.
follow_ups: Starts the three Sage's Wisdom riddles and opens When the Culling Gets Tough (Dwayne). Finishing leads to Sealed History.

item_hints.Spirit Compass: Chest on the top platform of the watchtower west of the Norgandian Settlement (follow Dorin, cross the bridge, climb the inside ladder). Shows a yellow minimap marker toward the Sphinx.
item_hints.Climbing Hook: Dorin gives you a spare after the tower, for the collapsed bridge on the route.
item_hints.Eye of the Sphinx: Given by the Sphinx when she poses the riddles. Use it from Items > Implements to mark strong foes; keep it, Into Rancor needs it.

name: Sage's Wisdom - Riddle of the Body
how: Talk to Dwayne in the Norgandian Inn until he keeps mentioning the giant, then rest at the inn until morning. A roar wakes everyone and marks the giant. Leave by the north gate to Nival Gorge Collapse (Dorin waits there with supplies), climb the left-hand slope and kill the Mournful Giant at the summit. The tusk drops automatically; deliver it to the Sphinx at the Shrine of Wisdom.
rewards: 25,000 XP, 20,000 G plus a Sphinx chest (Norgan Portcrystal per two guides); giant kill about 79,500 XP and 5,000 G
warnings: The giant only appears after you rest at the inn until morning; searching the mountains before that does nothing.
Use fire (a pawn's Fire Boon), break its tusks to stagger it, dodge the freezing breath and watch for avalanches on the slope.
Deliver the exact Mournful Giant's Tusk; other loot from it is rejected.
follow_ups: One of three riddles needed to finish Seeking the Sage.

item_hints.Mournful Giant's Tusk: Drops automatically when the Mournful Giant dies. Rest at the Norgandian Inn until morning, exit the north gate and follow it past Nival Gorge Collapse to the summit.

name: Sage's Wisdom - Riddle of the Soul
how: Jiera points you to Beorcan Stronghold (northwest, permanent blizzard). Skip the locked main gate: follow the outer wall left past the frozen soldiers to the logs, clear the snow over a hidden ladder, cross underground, climb the far ladder and go past a riftstone up to the courtyard. Kill the frost wyrm Fimbl and deliver its Frozen Wyrmslife Crystal to the Sphinx.
best: Use fire enchantments and hit Fimbl's exposed chest heart when it is staggered; finish fast before the late hailstorm wears the party down.
rewards: 25,000 XP, 20,000 G plus a Sphinx chest (guides list 3,000 or 6,000 RC); killing Fimbl ends the stronghold blizzard
warnings: Fimbl's final phase summons a damaging hailstorm; bring ice resistance or burst it down.
Bring at least 3 Heatstones for the permanent blizzard.
The main gate needs two Beorcan's Twinned Keys, but those only open optional rooms; use the hidden ladder instead.
The crystal is under Valuables on the Sphinx's Deliver screen.
follow_ups: One of three riddles needed to finish Seeking the Sage.

item_hints.Frozen Wyrmslife Crystal: Drops from the frost wyrm Fimbl in the Beorcan Stronghold courtyard. Enter via the hidden snow-covered ladder by the logs. Listed under Valuables.
item_hints.Heatstone: Smash Beorcan firepits, pick them up at campsites like Rivercave Campground, buy from Aymond or Ilda (3,000 G, limited) or craft Sunstone + Molten Ore.

name: Sage's Wisdom - Riddle of the Will
how: Polyeidus points you back to the Mountain Stronghold arena where you fought the Fallen Dragon (Rivercave Campground portcrystal is close). Pick up the Decorative Brooch near the center by the big floor pattern; ghouls spawn and rubble blocks the arch. Climb the fallen blocks by the wall, drop into the lower courtyard and get out, then deliver the brooch to the Sphinx.
rewards: 25,000 XP, 20,000 G plus a Sphinx chest (Eternal Wakestone per two guides)
warnings: Taking the brooch spawns a ghoul horde and seals the way in. You don't need to kill them; just escape with it.
The escape shows 'No Destination' on the map; find the way out yourself.
follow_ups: One of three riddles needed to finish Seeking the Sage.

item_hints.Decorative Brooch: On the ground near the middle of the Mountain Stronghold arena (where you first fought the Fallen Dragon), by the large floor pattern. Taking it spawns ghouls.

name: The Castle in the Ice
how: Take the Mountain Stronghold lift east and follow Eir to the dark ice wall. Hook down, pass Icefall Tunnels to Gagana's Grotto, and burn a Nokken body on each of the three altar braziers to summon the gagana; kill it for Firebird Tallow. Load it into the stronghold ballista (Examine) and shoot the ice wall. Reach Lorade Castle's throne, make the choice, then talk to the Sphinx to finish.

choices.option: Agree not to harm the corpse
choices.outcome: Eir explains Rovall became the Fallen Dragon. Talk to the Sphinx (weapon sheathed) to finish; Soul Searching and Where There's a Will start.
Eir turns hostile and is killed; the body turns to dust, the Fallen Dragon burns a settlement and 'This tale has ended'. Only reloading undoes it.

best: Agree not to harm the corpse. Striking it three times is a game-ending bad ending.
rewards: No quest reward screen; the gagana kill gives about 156,000 XP
warnings: Hard save before the throne room. Striking the body three times turns Eir hostile and ends the game; only a reload undoes it.
The gagana takes only 0.2x fire damage; use ice and hit its flame sac. Its talons poison and its breath sets the ground alight.
Each brazier needs a Nokken body burning on it: two Nokken are in the main area, one in nearby caves. Carry bodies with the grab button.
Only the ballista loaded with Firebird Tallow breaks the ice wall; normal attacks do nothing.
follow_ups: Agreeing leads to Soul Searching and Where There's a Will, There's a Way. Opens Quilt Me Down with a Feather, No Spoils Get Left Behind and Hal's Treasure Hunt.

item_hints.Spirit Compass: Reused from Seeking the Sage to navigate the whiteout to Gagana's Grotto.
item_hints.Firebird Tallow: Loot from the gagana after you burn a Nokken body on each of the three altar braziers in Gagana's Grotto and kill it. Cannot be sold. Use it on the stronghold battlement ballista.
item_hints.Climbing Hook: A spare hangs on the winch post in the Mountain Stronghold winch house; needed at the tether post down to the tunnels.
item_hints.Gagana Tallow: Dropped by Gagana after you place Nekkon bodies on the three altar pyres and defeat it. Load it into the stronghold ballista to break the ice wall to Lorade Castle.

name: Soul Searching
how: With Polyeidus's Transcription Kit, copy three slabs in the cave at the west end of the Norgan Snowfield trench; deliver them, wait a day, talk again. Free Morgus from a Blemmyae in Putrid Copse, blast the castletown gate with explosive casks, reach Abyss Ridge. The quest pauses during Where There's a Will, then ends at Mordria Fault when you pull the glowing sword from the cliff-edge rock.
rewards: 240,000 XP, 35,000 G, 3,000 RC (one guide also saw a 180,000 XP version)
warnings: It pauses after Abyss Ridge; continue Where There's a Will (statues, rift). It resumes at Mordria Fault and completes when you wake in the Norgandian Inn.
The cracked disc in the circular hall cannot be copied or repaired; skip it. Only the three intact slabs count.
A Blemmyae can swallow party members; hit its mouth to free them. Bring a Climbing Hook (used twice) and a Wakestone.
At Mordria Fault the Fallen Dragon cannot be killed; helping Eir with the rampart ballistas is optional.
follow_ups: Together with Where There's a Will, There's a Way, leads to Reunion.

item_hints.Transcription Kit: Given by Polyeidus at the Sealed Study when the quest starts; use it on the three carved slabs in the snowfield cave.
item_hints.Climbing Hook: Needed twice. Dorin gives one in Seeking the Sage, one is in the Northwall Campground chest, and Aymond sells them.

name: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
how: With your main pawn, help Eir relight Lorade Castle's barrier statues (she throws you up to raised ladders), then seal the rift by killing three spectres. Later Jiera sends you to the Sphinx: kill the demon attacking her and ride her to Mordria Temple. Descend, take the Temple Key from a dead soldier, beat Willan Barbatos, then choose 'Plunge in the Godsbane blade' and kill him in the portal.
rewards: 220,000 XP, 35,000 G, 3,000 RC, Lv 4 Ancient Helm, Plastron x2, Greaves
warnings: The Sphinx won't fly you back and you are committed once you land at the temple; restock and rest before talking to her.
Main pawn required: Eir won't proceed if you only have hired pawns.
Skip the temple elevator on the way in; it goes up. Keep descending to the locked portcullis.
The blemmyae at the gate is weak to lightning; its oil on the floor makes using fire dangerous.
follow_ups: Willan's death returns the heart to the Fallen Dragon; leads to Reunion.

item_hints.Temple Key: Mordria Temple: touching the locked portcullis summons a blemmyae. After killing it, search the dead soldier by a carved pillar next to a Curvestone ore vein, then choose Open at the gate.

name: Reunion
how: Starts once Willan Barbatos is dead and Rovall's body, soul and will are restored. Guides disagree on the start point (Eir at the Mordria Temple elevator, or the dragon at Abyss Ridge); follow the quest marker. Kill the Fallen Dragon, which is now mortal. After the scenes you wake in the Norgandian Inn; that completes the quest.
rewards: 450,000 XP, 100,000 G, 10,000 RC, Norgan Portcrystal
warnings: Once you go to the dragon you cannot back out; heal, repair, restock and set pawns first.
The dragon takes extra slash and strike damage, but several of its parts take none; hit exposed spots.
follow_ups: Into Rancor starts when you wake (Ruin-Night). Opens Beyond Ruin-Night and A Keepsake, for Your Sake.

name: Into Rancor
how: Starts on waking after Reunion. Talk to Dorin, then Polyeidus at Castletown Campground; at Abyss Ridge the Pathfinder gives the Soulless Godsbane Blade. Mark Rancor's Vortexes with the Eye of the Sphinx, Examine each and clear its enemy waves. Once the blade becomes the Blade of Rancor (about four vortexes), use 'Proffer the blade' at the Abyss Ridge edge, jump in and kill Satanachia. You wake at the inn; done.
rewards: 500,000 XP, 100,000 G, 15,000 RC, Lv 5 Ancient Helm, Ancient Bowstaff, Ancient Light Weaponry
warnings: The Satanachia fight starts the moment you land in Niflhel; stock curatives, Wakestones and buffs before jumping.
The quest log does not mark vortexes; use the Eye of the Sphinx. You cannot leave a vortex arena until every foe is dead.
Not a point of no return: Norgan stays open afterwards. Using the Blade of Rancor at Abyss Ridge again restarts Ruin-Night.
follow_ups: Ends the Norgan story ('Dogma Defended' trophy).

item_hints.Soulless Godsbane Blade: Given by the Pathfinder at Abyss Ridge (long staircase east of Lorade Castletown). Fills as you clear vortexes and becomes the Blade of Rancor. Cannot be sold.
item_hints.Eye of the Sphinx: From the Sphinx in Seeking the Sage. Use it from Items > Implements (retrieve it from storage if stored) to show vortexes as purple swirls on the map.

name: Hammer and Tongs
how: Talk to Hal, the injured smith at the forge by a thatched hut in the Norgandian Settlement (hold the talk button). Go after dark to the abandoned village north then east of the settlement; the Winterweed Blossom glows along the cliff bases facing east and south. Return to Hal, choose Deliver and confirm to finish; no waiting needed.
best: Go after dark so the blossom glows. Afterwards choose Manufacture with Hal to craft Norgan gear (5,000-15,000 G each).
rewards: 6,000 XP, Azure Ore, Snowoak Bark; unlocks Hal's workshop (Manufacture)
warnings: Beorcan raiders often patrol the abandoned village; if underleveled, sneak in or use Smoke Screen to break pursuit.
Only one blossom is needed; keep one aside for the hand-in.
follow_ups: Hal's Manufacture menu opens (37 items at first) and grows as the main story advances.

item_hints.Winterweed Blossom: A wild flower, not sold by Hal. Grows in the abandoned village north then east of the Norgandian Settlement, along the cliff bases facing east and south. Petals glow at night; by day they blend in. One is enough.

name: In for a Hare, in for a Hound
how: After Chilling Tidings, talk to Ilsa, standing with the direwolf Freki just inside the settlement's stone archway gate. Kill an Alpine Hare (Valgr Ravine past the gate, or Norgandian Foothills above Lake Norgan) and loot its meat. Deliver it to Ilsa, follow Freki through Valgr Ravine to a chest among standing stones above Lake Norgan, open it, then tell Ilsa to finish.
best: Afterwards take Freki on walks and feed her meat; she leads you to treasure chests, better meat gives better chests.
rewards: 10,000 XP, Scrag of Beast x3; unlocks Freki's treasure walks
warnings: Stay close to Freki; if you stray too far she stops guiding and you must restart the walk from Ilsa.
Freki won't fight on the walk; clear the serpents and harpies yourself.
Hares flee; use a bow, spell or pawn (a pawn kill counts). The meat rots over time, so deliver it promptly.
follow_ups: A Direwolf Delicacy (Ilsa approaches you in the settlement), then A Hound and His Bone.

item_hints.Alpine Hare Meat: Loot from a small white Alpine Hare in Valgr Ravine (just past the settlement gate) or the Norgandian Foothills above Lake Norgan. Put one in Ilsa's 'Specified Delivery Only' slot.

name: The Truant Soldier
how: Talk to Chrona beside Wash in the Mountain Stronghold hall; it starts automatically. Ride the lift down to the Norgan Snowfield and head northeast from the wooden shack through the whiteout to a ravine rim where Amos calls for help. On his ledge across the ravine, kill every Beorcan and Nokken. Then hold talk on Amos at the back of the Northwall Campground cave to finish; same day is fine.
best: Bring a Climbing Hook and cold protection, then talk to Amos at Northwall Campground right after the fight.
warnings: Finishing: the quest only completes when you hold the talk button on Amos at the back of the Northwall Campground cave; a tap only hails him.
One guide says a Climbing Hook is needed to reach Amos's ledge unless your vocation is nimble; there is a tether post there.
The whiteout blanks the minimap; follow the quest banners.
follow_ups: Amos then asks you to find merchant Aymond, starting The Stranger in the Snowfield.

name: Quilt Me Down with a Feather
how: After The Castle in the Ice, get it from roaming merchant Aymond. At Gagana's Grotto, kill three Nokken (lizards) nearby and drop their bodies at the cave entrance to lure the gagana out. Hit it until it flees, cling on, and it carries you to its nest; take the feather from the center. Give it to Aymond, rest at the settlement inn, then talk to him again to finish.
best: After handing over the feather, rest at the Norgandian Inn, then talk to Aymond again for the Firebird Cloak.
rewards: 20,000 G, 50,000 XP, Firebird Cloak
warnings: Handing over the feather is not the end: rest at the inn until the objective says the reward is ready, then talk to Aymond again.
The nest is too high to climb; the only way up is clinging to the gagana as it flees.
Aymond roams, usually at the Norgandian Settlement; after The Stranger in the Snowfield he stays at Northwall Campground.
follow_ups: Unlocks Back to the Temple (escort into Mordria Temple, branching rewards); Aymond starts selling Lv 4 spoils.

item_hints.Firebird's Plume: Guides also call it Gagana's feather; exact item name unconfirmed. Taken from the center of the gagana's nest above Gagana's Grotto, reached only by clinging to the fleeing gagana.

name: No Spoils Get Left Behind
how: After The Castle in the Ice, talk to commission soldier Chrona; she dropped her haul fleeing an ambush near Putrid Copse. Go to Putrid Copse, recover the spoils at the quest marker and bring them back to Chrona to finish. Guides do not document the steps in detail yet.

name: Beyond Ruin-Night
how: Post-story quest that opens after Reunion. Read the letter left on the spare bed in the Norgandian Inn to start it, then follow the quest marker; guides do not document the later steps yet.
warnings: Only appears after the main quest Reunion is completed.

name: Sticks and Stones
how: After Chilling Tidings, talk to Morgus on the Lake Norgan shore by the sunken stone bridge (northwest of the settlement). Throw a Climbing Hook at the tether post, climb, follow him to the camp past the ruined arch, kill the Beorcans and wolves and smash the firepit for Heatstones. Deliver 3 Heatstones to Ryatt near the well in the settlement (set quantity to 3) to finish.
best: Any Heatstones you already carry count toward the three, wherever you got them.
rewards: 10,000 G, 3,000 XP, Sunstone, Molten Ore
warnings: Sources disagree: one says the first firepit gives all three Heatstones, another says one each and Morgus marks more firepits on your map.
Clear the enemies before smashing a firepit, or the Pick Up prompt won't appear.
You need a Climbing Hook for the tether post at the start.
Have three Heatstones on you when you talk to Ryatt; don't use them up first.
follow_ups: Unlocks A Howl in the Dark (track the blackdog that took Morgus's pendant).

item_hints.Heatstone: Smash Beorcan firepits (the camp with Morgus, a standing-stone clearing south-southeast of the settlement, a ruined fort terrace above Lake Norgan). Also at campsites like Rivercave Campground, sold by Aymond and Ilda (3,000 G, limited), or crafted from Sunstone + Molten Ore or Sunstone + Warming Salve.
item_hints.Climbing Hook: Sold by Aymond; Dorin also gives one during Seeking the Sage.

name: The Stranger in the Snowfield
how: Some in-game days after The Truant Soldier, walk up to Amos in the Northwall Campground cave; he starts it on his own. Go to the map circle (about 400 m E, 300 m S of camp) and walk NW from its center into Frozen Ravine Hollow. Kill every Bugaboo around Aymond, then he talks automatically. Walk back to Amos in the campground cave; the reunion scene ends the quest.
best: Worth doing early: Aymond then trades at Northwall Campground (Climbing Hooks, Regeneration Elixirs, Norgan Ducats) at 5% off.
warnings: Aymond will not talk until every Bugaboo in the hollow is dead.
No pin until you spot him: walk NW from the circle center until the 'caught sight of a stranger' banner appears.
Talking to Aymond is not the end; you must walk back to Amos in the campground cave.
follow_ups: Aymond sells at Northwall Campground: Climbing Hook 5,000 G, Regeneration Elixir 10,000 G, Norgan Ducat 10,000 G, rings 10,000-20,000 G. After Quilt Me Down with a Feather he also sells Lv 4 spoils.

name: The Snatching-Beast
how: After Rumbles in the North, talk to Wash (hooded archer) in the Mountain Stronghold pillared hall. Take the stronghold elevator into the snowfield and follow the dropped loot to the lair cave. Pick up the five Commission Supplies packs (two before the boss, three in the boss room), kill the sleeping snowfoot, then deliver the packs to Wash in the Northwall Campground cave or at Castletown Campground.
best: Collect all five packs and hand them in unopened for the top payout: 30,000 G, three Lv 3 Ancient spoils and 3 rare Abandoned Supplies.
rewards: 40,000 XP always. All five packs: 30,000 G, Abandoned Supplies (Rare) x3, Lv 3 Ancient spoils (Bowstaff, Long Weaponry, Light Weaponry). Fewer packs: 25,000 or 20,000 G and fewer supplies.
warnings: Delivery accepts partial batches, but the gold and spoils tier depends on how many packs you return; bring all five before finishing.
Opening a pack gives its contents (heatstones, cures) but costs you the top payout.
Snowfoot: about 240,000 HP, weak to lightning, resists fire; pawn lightning can stagger it into a wall.
Guides disagree on exact pack spots near the entrance; check ledges and behind breakable crates and barrels.

item_hints.Commission Supplies (Thermal): Snatching-Beast's lair, first chamber past two saurians: floor corner by a leaning crate (VGC: lower level, behind breakable barrels). Deliver to Wash.
item_hints.Commission Supplies (Curatives): Lair hall, on a stone block/ledge topped with crates (allthings: left side; VGC: right side, breakable crate up on a ledge). Deliver to Wash.
item_hints.Commission Supplies (Rare Armor): Boss room, rear rock ledge behind the snowfoot's dais, beside a small keg. Deliver to Wash.
item_hints.Comm. Supplies (Rare Curatives): Boss room, same rear ledge as the Rare Armor pack, other side of the keg. Deliver to Wash.
item_hints.Comm. Supplies (Rare Weaponry): Boss room floor against the cave wall, behind stacked breakable crates. Deliver to Wash.

name: Flight in the Night
how: After Oh, to Be in Vermund, Ilda approaches you in the Norgandian Settlement; pick 'Wait for nightfall' (time skips to night). Walk her to three markers where she gathers Norgan salmon, winterweed blossom and coldstools herself; kill the ambush at the coldstools. Escort her to Polyeidus in the Sealed Study, take the Letter to Dorin, and deliver it to Dorin at the settlement bonfire to finish.
best: Stay within about 15 m of Ilda and clear the coldstool ambush; arriving after dawn does not fail the quest.
rewards: 70,000 XP, 2,000 RC; one listed outcome adds Regeneration Elixir x1 (condition unknown).
warnings: Reaching the Sealed Study needs main quest Sealed History, and the quest only ends when you deliver the Letter to Dorin, not at the study.
Ilda stops if you get about 15 m ahead; keep her alive against Beorcans, direwolves, undead and aethons at the coldstools.
Guides disagree: VGC has you fish, climb a ladder for the blossom and Ferrystone her to the Commission camp. Follow your quest markers.
follow_ups: Ilda later sells her gathered goods at Northwall Campground.

item_hints.Letter to Dorin: Given by Ilda when Polyeidus accepts her at the Sealed Study. Deliver to Dorin at the Norgandian Settlement bonfire (he walks up to you).

name: A Keepsake, for Your Sake
how: Post-story, after the main quest Reunion. Consult Polyeidus at the Sealed Study about a tremor to the north and follow the quest markers. Guides do not yet document the steps in detail; the quest ends with a choice between two rewards.

choices.outcome: Teaches the Proficiency augment: the top-level version of weapon skills costs less Stamina (partly stacks with Zeal).
Half of the 20 Ducats Dwayne charges for Augmentum Scriptura (7th augment slot).

best: Take the Treatise on Proficiency: it only comes from this quest, while Ducats come from appraisals, rubble, enemies and Aymond (10,000 G each).
warnings: The two rewards are exclusive; you get one or the other.
Augmentum Scriptura (20 Ducats) is in Dwayne's Trade Norgan Ducats menu at the Norgandian Inn.

name: Village Defense
how: After Rumbles in the North, tell Dorin at the settlement bonfire 'I am ready to defend the village' (daytime). Meet Dwayne by a boulder in Valgr Ravine; talking to him turns it to night. Clear wolves and harpies in the ravine, then wolves breaching the south palisade, then three large beasts inside the village. The quest ends when the last beast dies and the bonfire scene plays.
best: Shop, store and swap pawns before accepting (fast travel locks), then keep Dwayne alive; ice and lightning help on the big beasts.
rewards: Ring of Toppling (more knockdown power bare-handed) plus 90,000 XP and 5,000 RC, 90,000 XP and 3,000 RC, or 10,000 XP and 500 RC depending on how the night goes. No gold.
warnings: Fast travel is locked from accepting until the last beast dies; Ferrystones fail (not consumed). Prepare first.
Keep Dwayne alive; he fights beside you all night and calls you to each breach.
What decides the reward tier is undocumented; a clean defense gives the top one.
follow_ups: Hal recovers and offers a wider range of equipment at his workshop.

name: Relics of the Past
how: Starts when you pick up your first unappraised spoil (relic) in Norgan. Take it to Jiera in the Norgandian Settlement and have her appraise it. Appraisal costs a few Rift Crystals per spoil, but she hands you 300 RC the first time, so it is free. The first appraisal ends the quest.
rewards: 3,000 XP; unlocks Jiera's appraisal service.
warnings: The relic only sets the gear category; the exact piece, stats and skill are random.
Norgan relic gear cannot be upgraded with the usual smithing (e.g. Dwarven forge); replace it with better appraisals.
follow_ups: Jiera keeps appraising spoils for RC; appraisals are also a source of Norgan Ducats.

name: When the Culling Gets Tough
how: Once in Norgan, talk to Dwayne at the Norgandian Inn entrance, pick 'I am', and kill the beorcan and white direwolves SE of the settlement. Then wait (no marker): keep playing; he asks for a second outing outside the inn, and later Dorin walks up to you at the bonfire. Follow Dwayne to Valgr Ravine, kill two saurians and a white griffin; Dwayne carrying Ilsa home ends it.
rewards: 25,000 XP, 500 RC, Ring of Brawling (boosts Strength when fighting bare-handed).
warnings: The wait has no marker or timer (about a day in-game in one run); do other quests and return to the settlement, Dorin finds you at the bonfire.
The white griffin must die to progress; grab its wings and use pawn lightning.
Prerequisite differs by guide: Chilling Tidings or Seeking the Sage.
follow_ups: Unlocks Bout of Passage: Dorin stops you outside the inn at night. Keep the Ring of Brawling for it.

name: Oh, to Be in Vermund
how: After Rumbles in the North, Ilda approaches you (or talk to her at her cart in the Norgandian Settlement). She wants three Vermund goods, asked for one at a time: a Rabbit Pelt, then a Noonbloom, then a Courtly Tunic. Hand each over on the Deliver screen; delivering the tunic ends the quest.
rewards: 5,000 XP, 1,000 RC, Boreal Tuber x1, Frigid Fungus x1.
warnings: Ilda wants three items, not just the pelt. Check inn storage first; you may already own them.
Do not buy the Courtly Tunic (listed at 155,000 G); loot one from a Vernworth chest instead.
follow_ups: Unlocks Flight in the Night (helping Ilda leave with the Commission).

item_hints.Rabbit Pelt: Kill a rabbit in Vermund (fields around Vernworth) and examine the body; Choppers can also drop it. Deliver first.
item_hints.Noonbloom: Wild flower, e.g. behind Myrddin's House near the cliff or on the hill NE of the Bridge of Theodracus the Second; also 600 G at the Flower Stand in Bakbattahl.
item_hints.Courtly Tunic: Vernworth: chest on the 2nd floor of Allard's Estate, master bedroom upstairs in the Comptroller's Home, or a chest in a corner room of Sven's Chambers (castle). Also a reward from The Ornate Box.

name: Reaching the Far Shore
how: Talk to Jiera; Polyeidus at the Sealed Study sends you to Ser Ryatt in the same room. Jiera marks a Fimbl north of the Mountain Stronghold: beat it twice until it flees to Lake Norgan, then kill it with the ballistas at the Deserted Lakeside Estate. Wait for the lake to freeze, cross the ice south to the cave chest for the Taillour-Crafte Treatise, and give it to Hal.
rewards: 10,000 G, 50,000 XP, 1,000 RC; unlocks transmog (Tailor Equipment) at Hal.
warnings: Freezing the lake: Await Weather Change alone did not work in one run. Camp at the fire ring NE of the estate, talk to Jiera, then check the lake.
Ballistas: hold the draw about 15 s; Fimbl attacks break them, so move to another (seven in total).
Do not swim the lake (Brine); on the ice, avoid the open water next to the ballista platforms.
follow_ups: Hal's Tailor Equipment changes gear appearance without changing stats. Delivering the treatise also makes Village Defense your priority quest.

item_hints.Taillour-Crafte Treatise: In a chest in a cave across Lake Norgan. After the lake freezes, step onto the ice just north of the ballista platforms, go round the west side of the Fimbl's remains and follow the ice south. Give to Hal (Jiera's husband, the smith).

name: Hal's Treasure Hunt
how: After The Castle in the Ice, talk to Hal. Walk close to each of four posts in Norgan Snowfield: W (west circle), N (Beorcan-patrolled ruins), S (hill by Riftstone of the Beloved), E (by a ruined castle's grand entrance). Where the E-W and N-S lines cross, drop through soft snow into a cave (or enter Snowslide Pass from the north), take the Rusted Ring and deliver it to Hal.
rewards: 20,000 G, 35,000 XP, Frostbright Ring (Hal restores the Rusted Ring: no freezing or blizzard stamina drain in Norgan).
warnings: Posts only register when you get close: search the slope by the riftstone (not the road) and outside the castle, not inside.
Give the ring to Hal himself, not Jiera's appraisal counter.

item_hints.Rusted Ring: On the ground near the center of the cave under the crossing of the E-W and N-S post lines (drop through soft snow, or enter Snowslide Pass from the north). Deliver to Hal.

name: A Howl in the Dark
how: After Sticks and Stones, Morgus in the Northwall Campground cave gives you the beast's hairs for the spirit compass. At night, follow the compass to a rocky hollow on the east side of Norgan Snowfield near the Obelisk of Benediction. Break the blackdog's aura with holy magick, kill it, loot the Fallen Pendant, then deliver it to Morgus.
warnings: The blackdog only appears at night; sit on the bench at the nearby ruined hut and Doze Off, or camp, to reach dark.
Its aura blocks all damage: break it with holy (Mage's Anodyne field, Holy grimoire, High Empyrean, Virtuous Bolt, The Exalted), strike fast, repeat when it returns.
About 150,000 HP; double damage from holy, resists fire.
If the Commission has moved to Lorade Castletown (mid Soul Searching), deliver to Morgus there.

item_hints.Fallen Pendant: Dropped by the blackdog (night only) in a rocky hollow, east Norgan Snowfield near the Obelisk of Benediction. Deliver to Morgus via the Deliver screen.

name: A Direwolf Delicacy
how: After In for a Hare, in for a Hound, talk to Ilsa in the Norgandian Settlement. The hounds want a Snowdeer Bone: kill a snowdeer (easy spot: north of the settlement along the river's south bank), examine the corpse to loot the bone, then deliver it to Ilsa to finish.
rewards: 20,000 XP, Beast-Steak x3, Hound's Scent Pouch x1.
warnings: Wrong items only earn hints, and after enough misses Ilsa names the treat; no penalty for guessing.
follow_ups: Unlocks A Hound and His Bone.

item_hints.Snowdeer Bone: Loot from a snowdeer corpse (shows as a rare item). Snowdeer roam most of Norgan; reliable spot north of the Norgandian Settlement along the river's south bank. Give to Ilsa.

name: A Hound and His Bone
how: Hail Ilsa at her fire basket: 'Have Freki search for her pup'. Ask Dorin (bonfire), Hal (forge, from the front) and Ilsa; Hal, once recovered, leads you NE of the forge to Skoll's Snowdeer Bone. Show it to Ilsa, use Freki's 'Give bone', follow her to a cave about 350 m SSW, pick up Skoll and walk him to Ilsa's fire basket; her scene ends the quest.
best: If offered a choice, take the Treatise on Lupinity: with Freki along, jumping and dashing cost 0.4x Stamina.
rewards: 60,000 XP, Alpine Hare Meat x3, Treatise on Lupinity. Quest lists say you pick the Treatise or a Hound's Scent Pouch; the walkthrough saw no choice.
warnings: Walk, do not jump, while carrying Skoll; jumping or falling drops him. Hold Grab to lift him again.
A Beorcan may wait at the cave entrance; be ready to fight.
Freki cannot go on walks with you during the search.
follow_ups: Final quest of Ilsa's hound chain.

item_hints.Skoll's Snowdeer Bone: Clearing NE of Hal's forge: squared grey stones on bare rock by a young fir, a few steps east of where Hal stops. Deliver to Ilsa (you keep it), then Freki's menu: Give bone.

name: Bout of Passage
how: After When the Culling Gets Tough, Dorin stops you outside the Norgandian Inn at night and asks you to join Dwayne's coming-of-age bout (or speak to Dwayne). You lay down your weapons and fight Dwayne with your fists. Guides do not yet document how the bout ends or what decides the reward.
best: Wear the Ring of Brawling (bare-handed Strength) and Ring of Toppling (bare-handed knockdown) for the fist fight.
rewards: One of five outcomes: 75,000 XP + 3,000 RC, or 50,000 XP + 1,500 RC (each with or without Regeneration Elixir x3 and Fungal Cure-All x3), or 20,000 XP only.
warnings: You get only one reward outcome, and what decides it (winning, losing, how you fight) is undocumented.
No weapons in this fight; only bare-handed damage counts.

name: The Obelisks of Benediction
how: Starts when you touch any Obelisk of Benediction in Norgan (nine, one per vocation). At each obelisk, offer an Offering Flame (earned by clearing Lost Rite trials) to unlock that vocation's superior skill and a one-time permanent stat boost.
best: Clear Lost Rites first so you carry a flame whenever you reach an obelisk.
rewards: Per obelisk: a vocation skill pair (e.g. Warrior: Iron Cleave/Steel Cleave) plus a one-time stat boost (e.g. Warrior: Health). No fixed XP/gold confirmed.
warnings: One list marks this quest losable. Lost Rites, the Offering Flame source, can be permanently failed once red clouds settle over the Sacred Arbor; start it early.
Warrior obelisk is in Mad-Lord's Chapel (cave just before the Shrine of Wisdom sage), guarded by strong enemies.
Trickster obelisk is east of the Magick Archer one; go around the chasm and up the mountain pass, not across.

item_hints.Offering Flame: Reward for each Lost Rite trial (challenge dungeons). Start: Captain Brant at The Stardrop Inn, Vernworth, after dark, option 'About the uncovered ruins'; the first trial gives the Proving Ground Compass to find the rest.

name: Back to the Temple
how: After Quilt Me Down with a Feather, meet Aymond at Castletown Campground (Lorade Castletown) and escort him and his party into Mordria Temple. Guides do not yet document the steps or how the escort ends; follow the markers and stay with Aymond.
best: Rest and restock first, then protect Aymond's party the whole way; what decides the reward tier is undocumented.
rewards: One of four outcomes: 100,000 G, 200,000 XP, 5,000 RC, Lv 4 Ancient Helm, Plastron and Greaves; 30,000 G, 100,000 XP, 2,000 RC, three Lv 4 spoils; 10,000 G, 50,000 XP, 1,000 RC, two Lv 4 spoils; or 20,000 XP, 500 RC.
warnings: Only one reward outcome; the conditions are undocumented (likely how well the escort goes).
Mordria Temple is dangerous; prepare as for a boss dungeon.
